title: Marble Tick Tack
summary: Pure animation bridge. No faces. Cabinet marble chorus at night walks a continuous lot — doorway onto a dirt alley with a copper Rodin torus, then an unreal green lawn whose electromagnet tower stands on the kick and slumps in the gap, then frozen ferrofluid rain that thaws at the dirt/grass seam — and chains home on the same shelf. Station objects hop; magnets travel. Roley Voss lane.
visualArc: Warm cabinet / marble chorus → cube slide to glasses → doorway onto dirt alley → Rodin torus against the fence → spheres rolling in ruts → fence gap onto impossible emerald lawn → electromagnet tower rise/slump → frozen ferrofluid rain at the threshold → thaw and smash → slick spheres home past the dry Rodin → cabinet chain lock → 3s decay hold.
